content: Azure Logic Apps Automation introduces new developer experiences that make it faster and easier to build, manage, and scale business process automation. Enhancements include a refreshed workflow designer, reusable templates, faster environment and application creation, and expanded regional availability. As organizations scale automation, developers need intuitive tools, reusable patterns, and simplified infrastructure setup to move from ideas to production faster. These enhancements streamline the development experience while reducing setup and operational complexity. With these improvements, customers can: Build workflows faster: Use a refreshed designer with improved visual navigation, clearer branching, and streamlined editing to create and manage complex workflows. Accelerate development with templates: Start with ready-to-use templates for integration, Azure operations, and agentic automation, or turn existing workflows into reusable templates that can be shared across teams. Get started more quickly: Create environments and applications faster with an optimized runtime foundation that reduces infrastructure provisioning overhead. Deploy across more regions: Take advantage of expanded availability across Azure public regions, with rollout underway. These enhancements help developers build automations faster, reuse proven patterns, and scale business processes with greater flexibility. Learn more.
